entities.name: Jul' Maroh
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jul Maroh is a French writer and illustrator of graphic novels who wrote Blue Is the Warmest Color, a story about the life and love of two young lesbians that was adapted by Abdellatif Kechiche into the film Blue Is the Warmest Colour.
